risks.title: Interest rate risk on debt
risks.score_rationale: The document indicates 2.2 billion dollars of outstanding treasury notes with fixed rates ranging from 3.250% to 5.875%. While the notes carry fixed rates, long-term exposure to debt remains substantial, particularly in the event of future refinancing or adverse market conditions.

risks.title: Volatility of operating cash flows
risks.score_rationale: Operating results declined 30.1% in 2025, primarily due to restructuring charges (109.1M), asset impairment charges (53.6M), and charges related to a fire (21.1M). These significant one-time impacts affect cash flow stability and reduce operational visibility.

risks.title: Acquisition and integration risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has completed significant acquisitions generating substantial goodwill. Successful integration and realization of expected synergies are critical to justify acquisition values and preserve profitability.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in multiple countries with geographic distribution: United States 84% (3,742.1M), Canada 8% (344.1M), China 3% (147.2M), Other International 5% (229.8M). Currency rate fluctuations had an unfavorable quantified impact of 2.3M USD on sales in 2025.

risks.title: Tariff and supply chain risk
risks.score_rationale: The company anticipates increased cost of goods sold based on announced or imposed tariffs. The company is working on mitigation through supply chain actions, cost-out initiatives, and strategic price adjustments, but acknowledges uncertainty regarding the full effectiveness of these measures.

risks.title: Liquidity management and fund repatriation
risks.score_rationale: A significant portion of liquidity is held by non-U.S. subsidiaries, and their repatriation could result in negative tax consequences. Management of these funds affects financial flexibility available for dividends, share buybacks, and strategic investments.

risks.title: Pension plan risk
risks.score_rationale: The company recently completed transactions to transfer pension plan obligations to insurers, resulting in one-time derisking losses. While intended to reduce future volatility, this represents a unique financial charge and could generate additional future impacts.

risks.title: Office consolidation and ongoing restructuring charges
risks.score_rationale: In January 2025, the company announced consolidation of U.S. regional offices into a single headquarters in Deerfield, Illinois. Estimated charges include relocation, severance, retention, non-liquid assets, and lease exit costs. The majority of charges (109.1M in 2025) have been incurred, with residual charges expected in 2026.
